brief: Holds a piece of 3D geometry in the engine, a primitive, an OBJ file or your own vertex layout, and reports its counts and format.
detail: A mesh knows its own attribute layout and the pipeline that draws it is derived from that layout, so a new attribute needs no change in the renderer; Format is that layout made visible. A cube is 24 vertices and not 8, because a shared corner cannot carry three face normals. The mesh lives in the engine and is released with Free; after that its counts answer -1. Building a mesh draws nothing and opens no window.
